issue: iOS section deletion popup closes without reliably deleting the selected section.
codeDefects: Confirmation read the selected ID from mutable presentation state, which dismissal could clear before the action.
Destructive buttons and navigation links shared automatic Form/List row button behavior.
changes: Use an explicit alert with captured action/section ID, Delete and Cancel, and draft/publication explanation for ordinary and regional sections.
Isolate inline destructive buttons and ordering menus with borderless button style.
Capture category/group/topic confirmation data with presenting instead of reading mutable state while building actions.
Keep the last visible ordinary section protected; permit removal of the last regional section.

verification.preFixUI: The original UI test failed waiting for the deletion confirmation. Its test failure is recorded in build/UAC-directory-delete-baseline-run-test.log; xcodebuild finalization was stopped after recording failure, so its partial xcresult is not valid final evidence.
uiScenarios: Existing ordinary section: Cancel preserves it; Delete removes it without navigating to the section editor; Publish becomes enabled; reopening the article retains deletion.
Existing regional section: Delete removes it; reopening the federal state retains deletion.

delegatedEditorAssertions: Ordinary registered user with enabled directoryEditors grant can save payload without deleted ordinary/regional sections.
Firestore reread confirms deletion and next revision; versions preserve previous and changed payload.
Reader, revoked grant and stale revision cannot restore sections; saved document remains unchanged.

limitations: UI tests use a mock owner session; delegated-editor persistence is verified separately through the real server handler against local Firestore Emulator, not a live staging iPhone login.
Deleting changes the category draft. Publishing the category persists the change for readers.
No production data changed, Firebase deployment or TestFlight upload performed.
